title: Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram (RBSK) Policy & Guidelines

nodes.title: 1. Programme Overview & Type
nodes.content:
Programme Name: Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram (RBSK)
Jurisdiction: India
Category: Child health screening and early intervention
Type: Public Healthcare Service
Details: Child health screening and early intervention addressing defects at birth, diseases, deficiencies and developmental delays including disabilities.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria & Conditions
nodes.content:
Eligibility: Children in age groups and settings covered by current RBSK guidelines, including newborns and children reached through public health and educational platforms.
Individual Enrolment Required: False

nodes.title: 3. Required Documents & Documentation
nodes.content: Required Documents: Child identity/age details and available health or school records; facility may specify additional records.

nodes.title: 4. Application Procedure & Access Desks
nodes.content:
Where to Apply / Access: Contact an RBSK mobile health team, Anganwadi centre, government school or public health facility, depending on age and location.
Official Portal: https://nhm.gov.in/
